thread:
maria: Quick check — PR #18982 is stuck in the CI queue, mac-e2e is flaking 2/3. Prefreeze for APAC is tomorrow and I don't want to drift into the blackout. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/18982
ci-bot: CI queued for PR 18982. mac-e2e reports intermittent failure. Rerun available.
ashok: If it's a flaky mac-e2e I'd prefer we don't punt the whole PR. Can we do a targeted rerun + local smoke and then land to canary? @oliver can you help with reruns?
maria: I can run the smoke locally but main has 2 commits ahead — rebase will take ~10m. I was hesitating because of the APAC deploy blackout window.
oliver: :wave: I can take the rebase and push. What time is the blackout?
release-manager: APAC deploy blackout is 2024-03-21 23:00–02:00 UTC. To avoid the blackout we need to land before 22:30 UTC. Otherwise this goes to next window.
ashok: Two options: A) rebase + targeted rerun + manual canary before blackout; B) wait for full CI queue and land in next window. I'm leaning A if we can get smoke + canary quickly.
maria: Will rebase in 5. Command I ran locally: ```git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease```
ci-bot: Rerun triggered on request by @oliver for PR 18982 (targeted mac-e2e).
oliver: Rebase done and pushed, kicked off targeted mac-e2e: ```./ci/run_tests --filter mac-e2e --pr 18982```
ci-bot: mac-e2e run started (1/3).
ci-bot: mac-e2e run passed (3/3) — all targeted runs green.
release-manager: :thumbsup: Good to go for a canary push. I'll schedule the canary rollout and monitor. If canary is green within 30m we'll proceed with merge before blackout cutoff.
maria: Thanks — I'll keep an eye on canary. If it passes can someone drop an /approve and I'll merge?
ashok: Dropped a review and will /approve once canary is green.
oliver: I also added a quick changelog note. Will watch alerts.
maria: Can confirm canary looks stable so far. Merging in ~5. Thanks everyone for quick help :heart:
